results.name: initial load, real data counts, creator separate from learner
all eleven modes start and finish; session counts are unique
exam difficulty and unit filters, total 45 minutes, last answer kept editable
settings persist after fresh page, export JSON, malformed import rejected
confirmed reset clears active session and does not resurrect it on reload
no browser JavaScript or console errors

notes: All data were isolated in fresh test browser contexts.

The historical game and persistence regressions use tests/fixtures/authorized-account.js injected into test responses only. It simulates an authorized non-admin account and an in-memory cloud endpoint; it does not test live email signup/login, email delivery, RLS or real cloud synchronization. Production HTML and auth configuration are not altered.
Account progress reset returns to the authenticated account display name; guest no-persistence behavior is covered by the separate authentication UI suite.

Some lifecycle tests call actual application functions directly using real bank questions. Native type controls, setup, exam navigation and backup controls are also exercised through actual DOM actions.
Timer expiry is accelerated by moving recorded start timestamps backward; no claim of a 45-minute wall-clock wait.
No testing on physical phones, Safari or Firefox.
scope: Selected historical game regressions on final email-auth build; not a new full historical suite run.
